name: OpenCode Server
description: Privacy-first AI coding agent that runs locally. Installs the official binary natively in an LXC (no Docker) as an always-on `opencode web` server with basic auth on port 4096.

notes.text: UI binds 0.0.0.0:4096 with basic auth (user opencode). Password is generated at install, shown once, and saved to /etc/opencode/opencode.env (0600).
Web UI: http://<container-ip>:4096; OpenAPI spec at /doc. Attach with `opencode attach http://<container-ip>:4096` or `opencode run --attach ... "<prompt>"`.
Config: /root/.config/opencode/config.json. Add provider keys with `opencode auth login` — stored at /root/.local/share/opencode/auth.json, container only.
Restart after a password change (`systemctl restart opencode` on Debian, `rc-service opencode restart` on Alpine). Unattended password: `var_opencode_password=...`.
Update: `update` inside the LXC or `pct exec <CTID> -- update` (runs `opencode upgrade --method curl` and restarts).
Alpine is supported via OpenRC. Logs: `journalctl -u opencode` on Debian, /var/log/opencode.log on Alpine.
